_about: Public-domain Johann Eduard Huther (1807-1880, pastor at Wittenförden) in English for the Word Hoard: his three volumes in Meyer's Critical and Exegetical Commentary, Timothy and Titus (1881), Peter and Jude (1881) and James and John (1882), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 30 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

huther-timothy-titus: Critical and Exegetical Handbook to the Epistles to Timothy and Titus, tr. David Hunter (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, MDCCCLXXXI)
huther-peter-jude: Critical and Exegetical Handbook to the General Epistles of Peter and Jude, tr. D. B. Croom and Paton J. Gloag (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, MDCCCLXXXI)
huther-james-john: Critical and Exegetical Handbook to the General Epistles of James and John, tr. Paton J. Gloag and Clarke H. Irwin (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, MDCCCLXXXII)

_alternates.huther-copies: Other 1881-1882 copies; the Funk & Wagnalls issues
